The Pur Minerals Disappearing Ink Concealer 4-in-1 is wonderful for hiding EVERYTHING completely without caking or settling into fine lines.  It is creamy and feels like it's moisturizing while hiding any issues we may find.  I absolutely love

The consistency is thin but not too thin - it covers really well and doesn’t feel cakey. And you can layer more on without it feeling too thick. My skin color is golden tan and the medium tone was perfect. It blends incredibly well. Rather than using the “pen” to apply, I still use my finger to apply for co

Can I give this 10 stars? I love this product. I've never found a concealer that matched my skin tone so perfectly, blends in wonderfully and does exactly what I need. Bout ready to throw out any other concealer I have cuz this is a miracle product for me. Love it.

reviews.t: great concealer, but pay for pen that is useless
reviews.x: PROS:  I love the product itself.  I wear Pur 4-n-1 pressed mineral foundation in Golden Medium and this goes great with it.  It goes on easy, gives just a little dewy look without being oily or cakey, stays in place all day, and does not settle in lines. CONS:  The pen applicator.  It's difficult to control exactly how much you get out, and it take a little time for the product to out after twisting for more.  So, I've found the easiest way to control how much product I get is to click it 3 or

I've been using this product for a couple of years now and like it but when it comes time to start using a new tube plan on spending 5-10 minutes tapping the base on the palm of your and twisting the bottom of the tube to get the concealer to FINALLY appear on the applicator tip.  This tip was given to me by the sales gal at Ulta where I purchased my first tube.  I would give it 5 stars if getting a new tube started were easier

I absolutely love this product. I have a face full of freckles, so it's hard to find a concealer that covers what needs to to covered and still lets my freckles shine through. I can say this is the first product that I feel does that for me. It doesn't "cake" on either. It almost becomes one with your skin. reviews.t: My only complaint about this is that it's a little darker than expected but a shade lighter for me and It'd be perfect.
reviews.x: This makeup and skin care line has changed my life. After having acne and large pores for 30 years my face is clear and improving daily. My only complaint about this is that it's a little darker than expected but a shade lighter for me and It'd be perfect.

This is the first concealer I’ve ever purchased and I will definitely continue going back to order this. Buying it on Amazon is SO simple and takes MUCH if not all of the hassle out of the process - thank you AMZN!  What I loved: 1. EXCELLENT coverage (I use this for my undereye concealer when needed which is mostly daily LoL) 2. Does not crease like MOST concealers do 3. Very easy to apply (I just apply with a foundation brush)

reviews.t: Great product, but the lightest shade is dark
reviews.x: The consistency of this concealer is fabulous — it feels light but provides a lot of coverage. However, their lightest shade is pretty dark with yellow undertones. I’m not super fair/porcelain, but I do typically choose the 2nd of 3rd lightest shades when ordering concealer or foundation. I read that it was a bit dark but figured since it’s summer and I’m tanner than I usually am, it’d probably be fine. reviews.t: A must have for my makeup routine!
reviews.x: I got a sample of this when I subscribed to Ipsy and I loved it. That was over 3 years ago and I'm still using the product. It's my go-to concealer for under eyes and redness in my cheek area. A little goes a long way. You have to make sure you blend well or fade it. For using it just in that area, it takes me months to go through one pen. It clicks to squeeze the liquid out in the sponge tip but when that's empty, I take the tip part of and use a blending brush to keep using it for another 10-1

reviews.t: Mine was thick and I think old.

It is light weight but it does lay in the wrinkles and doesn’t fully cover up the dark circles around my eyes
Perfect concealer and lasts quite a while.  I reorder this when it's close to being gone.

Pur concealer is perfect.  It spreads easily, blends in nicely and does the job.  Even my undereye dark circles are minimized. I use a cream consealer  under foundation then top off with Estee Lauder Smoothing Consealer - only they discontinued it! I tried the Pur product as a replacement. It only contains 3.5ml compared to EL's 15ml for about the same price. I think a lot of product also

reviews.x: I received a sample of this in a little squeeze tube. Great coverage, went on smoothly, loved it. I went online to buy the full size, but it is only available as a pen.  The pen is NOT good at all. I turn the end of the pen to dispense the concealer and it does not flow to the sponge tip consistently. I either barely get enough concealer on the sponge tip applicator, or a big blob of concealer.......there is no middle ground. Very disappointed overall. I much prefer the squeeze tube sample. This

reviews.x: The white felt tip is a terrible way to apply but more importantly mine was already opened before i received as the product had already pulled through to the white tip and dried.  Gross.  I tested the mechanism for getting more to the tip and it really does take some time. I cant comment on the color or blending but the mechanism is clunky, and i would not buy this on amazon. I appreciate amazons return policy, but there are cases where products need to be checked before getting put back in the

I usually like PUR cosmetics.  This concealer is ok, but nothing different from other tubed concealers I have used. A couple of the other reviewers mentioned how difficult it was to get cream to come up the tube.  I found that as well.  I had to keep twisting the bottom much longer than I expected before the cream worked its way into the small sponge at the top.  A bit irritating, but it did finally come out.  The price was ok, delivery was good.

I originally bought this in a store through a consultant. It was very easy to reorder on Amazon and I think a bit cheaper. It doesn't look like you have makeup on when I use this. It's not like others that look cakey if my skin is a little dry that day. I throw a little on under my eyes and on a couple spots and it last the while day. Even holds up good when you sweat.

I am writing this review because I almost didn't purchase due to reviews saying the pen was extremely hard to get working and that would have been a shame!!! The pen is extremely EASY to work if you twist the bottom as designed!!!! As for the product....I love it as I do all PUR products. Don't be afraid of user error reviews!

I was first introduced to this product when I went to Ulta looking for new light weight makeup.  I’m absolutely obsessed with the PUR line and so happy I’m able to purchase this from Amazon now. No need to go to the mall and fight the crowds. I am one happy mama!

This pen is awesome. It covers great with only a very small amount. It also reduces my bags within seconds. I only gave it 4 stars because of how difficult it is to get it to dispense. Fix this and I'll give it a 10!
I was looking for a really moisturizing product that would no dry out or crease. This is not that product. It is easy to work with but it dies settle into fine lines and creases.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the concealer's coverage and blendability, often calling it their favorite or go-to product.
Many reviewers complain about the pen applicator, saying it is difficult to get product to the tip and requires excessive twisting or tapping.
Several reviewers note the shades run darker than expected, including the lightest shade.
Some reviewers say the product does not settle into lines and stays in place all day, while a few report the opposite.
A few reviewers describe the consistency as thin but not cakey, while others found theirs thick or old.
